text:
laura: Bringing up newt13b (int4) canary on dedicated pool-7. Intermittent OOMs after ~1-2k tokens on long conversations. stack trace points to KV alloc failure, looks like fragmentation rather than a single large alloc. anyone seen this pattern?

mike: yep. sounds like prefetched KV + small, bursty requests. fragmentation accumulates. what are your batching/prefetch settings?

laura: default model config from catalog. excerpt: ```
model: newt13b-int4
batching: { mode: auto, max_batch_tokens: 8192 }
prefetch: true
max_new_tokens: 512
kv_cache: { enabled: true, shrink_threshold: 0.0 }
```

anita: interesting — shrink_threshold 0.0 disables proactive KV trimming. on mem-tight GPUs that can let tiny slices pile up. could reproduce locally by spamming short requests.

anita: repro log locally: ```
[2026-02-14 09:12:03] ERROR: alloc_kv_cache failed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[2026-02-14 09:12:03] INFO: free_mem=324MB, fragmentation=~41%
[2026-02-14 09:12:03] WARN: falling back to smaller batch or OOM
```

sam: quick patch idea — enable kv_trim_by_age and set shrink_threshold to 0.2, reduce prefetch window, and default max_new_tokens -> 256 for this variant. that should reduce long-lived small allocations.

ryan: also add a slow-start concurrency ramp on canary so we don't cold-run into frag immediately. example rollout config: ```
canary: { percent: 5, slow_start: 0.15, ramp_interval_s: 600 }
model_defaults: { max_new_tokens: 256 }
kv: { shrink_threshold: 0.2, trim_by_age: true, prefetch_window: 2 }
```

mike: good. +1 to `prefetch_window: 2` (was 8 in some deployments). If this fixes it we can add a targeted perf/eval job to ensure quality unchanged.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: canary_id=can-20260214-71 pool=pool-7 model=newt13b-int4 config=kv_shrink_r0.2_pref2_maxnew256

infra-bot: Note: reduced prefetch may slightly increase avg latency in short prompts. tracking on console: /dash/model/newt13b-int4/can-20260214-71

qa-bot: Running regression eval set (conv-long, code-gen, summarization). will post diffs in #eng-ml after run.

laura: applying patch to canary now. will collect mem histograms and token latency slices. thanks for the fast triage :thumbsup:

mike: if it still OOMs, try forcing KV eviction policy to LRU+age and enable small-slot compaction on the allocator. but let's see after this patch.

laura: noted. I'll also add a periodic kv_compact cron for pool-7 while we monitor. will update thread with results later.

anita: fyi leaving a short note in the model onboarding checklist to set these defaults for int4 variants until we have model-specific allocator heuristics.

laura: thanks all — saving outputs under s3://redwood-canary/newt13b/20260214/ and will ping when QA diffs are in.
